description: Forbidden generic documentation-expansion debris. These signatures identify agent-generated 'CFD Reader Guidance' tails that were appended uniformly to 51 pages and removed during the documentation overhaul. Matching is deterministic and exact after whitespace normalization; fuzzy prose similarity is deliberately NOT used, because legitimate operational guidance can resemble parts of the template.
forbidden_headings: ## CFD Reader Guidance and Practical Use
### What To Extract Before Changing A Case
forbidden_fragments: within the PICurv workflow. For CFD users, the most reliable reading strategy is to map the page content to a concrete run decision
Treat this page as both a conceptual reference and a runbook.
Record failure signals that require rollback or parameter isolation.
rationale: The tails consumed roughly 12% of the docs/pages corpus while carrying no page-specific information, reducing information density and polluting search results. A page needing operating or troubleshooting guidance must state something specific to its own subject.
scaffold_note: SCAFFOLD-INCOMPLETE is emitted by scaffold_documentation.py and must be removed by the author once every placeholder is replaced. Structural correctness and completion are separate conditions: a skeleton is deliberately shaped to satisfy the structural audits, so without this marker an untouched scaffold could be published as finished.
